rationale: Although the title references 'Lacking Sanitation Governance' and Section 3.4 briefly mentions national policies as general background recommendations, the empirical analysis tests no legal, regulatory, institutional, or administrative rule mechanism (NONE_NO_RULE_MECHANISM). Using secondary country-level data across 154 countries from GBD 2021 and WHO (2000-2021) combined with BAPC and ARIMA projections to 2030, Comparable Risk Assessment, and decomposition analysis (observational ecological/epidemiological modeling), the study's focal outcome is Deaths Attributable to Unsafe Sanitation in Rural areas (DAUSRs) and age-standardized diarrheal mortality rates—a health/mortality endpoint rather than a household WASH access outcome (NONE_NO_ACCESS_OUTCOME), with rural toilet/sewer coverage proportions modeled via ARIMA as one of the four driving exposure factors of mortality.
